summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper (os and json only), exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. A check found no lines over 120 columns in the new or edited files, but black was not run, so formatting is unverified. Choices beyond the spec: ValueError is raised when the top level is not an object or the key's value is not a list; json decode errors propagate as their ValueError subclass; items are shallow-copied before resolution.
